title: Flush: 25min very easy or easy spin
terrain: flat, or indoor trainer if the legs are heavy
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 25min, Z1, flat. If the quads are sore from Saturday's 1000m descent, take the bike instead - same duration, easy spin, no impact.
GYM: hip abductor block, light.
FUEL: water only.
STOP RULE: quad soreness from the descent is expected and fine. Lateral knee pain is not, and it means the descent cap was still too high - report it, because it changes race-day descent strategy, not the training.
WHY: taper starts here. Nothing between today and 12 September adds fitness; every session from now is about arriving able to run downhill.
